title: First registration: ssh.management on cats1
summary: ssh.management is xtpd's first registration and cats1 (ed209g, 20.0.154.12) its first field node, with ed209k as client. Steps: build and test locally (libxtp dev38, xtpd v0.1, OpenSSH with ProxyUseFdpass to sshd -i); install on cats1 beside port 22; prove several sessions, a copy and a reboot; close tcp 22 under a 10-minute dead-man revert; then disable sshd's listener, remove the Azure NSG rule and audit against contract v0.4. Every machine change goes to CODEX-PC marked NEEDS TOM'S DIRECT APPROVAL. Once 22 is gone XTP is the only door; the fallback is redeploying a disposable VM.
authority: design (architecture Tom Dyer; written by Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: Port 22 stays open until SSH over XTP has survived a reboot
Every machine change needs Tom's direct approval
procedure: Follow the six steps in order; stop at the first failure
